=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- docs/INVENTORY.md:Lines 218-220 | severity=blocker | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The new release gate script is absent from the script inventory.
  WHY: The supplied CI run fails `tests/inventory_parity.py` with `Scripts: missing scripts/release_ci_gate.sh`, so this PR’s CI check fails.
- scripts/auto_release_stable.sh:Lines 202-204 | severity=blocker | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: Stable-ref releases can still execute the older, ungated workflow revision.
  WHY: A stable-only patch released before the updated workflow reaches `stable` is dispatched to the `stable` ref, where the old workflow can tag without running `release_ci_gate.sh`; this path can still release a SHA without the required CI check.
- agents.md:"Stable log prefixes (contractual)" section | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The `RELEASE_CI_GATE` log prefix is not registered in the contractual `LOG_PREFIX.name=...` list.
  WHY: Workflow-log-analysis and API-hygiene reporting depend on the stable log-prefix registry to map prefixes back to workflows; an unregistered prefix is invisible to those downstream tools.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
